scope: all Powerhouse chats, agents, workflows, portal capabilities, CRM/enrichment/revenue/content/decision intelligence
problem: Powerhouse already had strong domain intelligence, CRM/relationship enrichment, decision cycles and outcome learning, but these could still be interpreted as separate subsystems instead of one company-wide intelligence and execution architecture.
proven_fix: Introduce a canonical Company Intelligence OS contract and runtime projection: Company Graph, System of Context, Autonomous Action Layer, Outcome Memory and Compound Intelligence Loop, all reusing existing stores and decision-cycle lineage.
prevention_rule: CRM is a source, never the brain. New company intelligence must project into the canonical graph/context/action/outcome/learning loop and may not create a parallel CRM, graph, context store or learning silo.
